name: com.meiqia.meiqiasdk.activity.MQInquiryFormActivity
description: When Meiqia has a pre-chat inquiry menu, this Activity shows the configured choices for routing a visitor to a support team or agent. A choice can lead to a contact form or directly into the conversation.
disableEffect: The Meiqia routing menu cannot open, so users may not reach the support team selected by the app.
